Messages.Body:
Shocking, I know, that someone is trying to use Aye/Orun, but I have a
quick question. Is Action timing such that I can use High Orun to
reduce the cost of, for example, Revelations?

--
- Gregory Stuart Pettigrew

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 2 Apr 2006 18:12:55 -0700, "gpett...@gmail.com"
<gpett...@gmail.com> wrote:

>Shocking, I know, that someone is trying to use Aye/Orun, but I have a
>quick question. Is Action timing such that I can use High Orun to
>reduce the cost of, for example, Revelations?

No, it cannot reduce the cost of the action card.

High Orun cannot be played until after the action card is played, so
its effect cannot be retro-actively applied to the action card.

See also, Magic of the Smith + Ankara Citadel.

Correct answer, but the parallel with Ankara retrieved by MotS isn't
really illuminating, since it is based on the fact that the Citadel
isn't in play (or even targeted/named/etc.) when the cost of the action
is paid.

High Orun only reduces the costs of cards played after playing High
Orun, though, so that is enough to disqualify the action card played to
start the action.
